parsed.explanation: The dossier is thin on trans-specific facts, so I extrapolated from structural signals. No trans-specific offence, facility rule, marker rule or trans-specific violence is documented, which keeps this above the severe band. The sexual-conduct provisions were read down in 2024 but remain on the books, and the 2011 submission and 2014 statement indicate enforcement against same-sex conduct has been largely dormant. Against that, police were documented as dismissive of anti-LGBT violence, recourse is thin, there is no anti-discrimination or gender-identity protection, and a 2010 killing of a man accused of gender- or sexuality-coded 'watching' shows lethal violence against gender-nonconforming people. A 2009 evangelical call for gay tourists to be kept out signals visitor-facing hostility, though not state action. Religious and civil-society voices supporting decriminalisation are a modest positive. Overall this is high-to-elevated risk, with the recorded violence and weak recourse outweighing the dormant statute.
